I approved PR #7. I posted the approval comment and added the `ai:approved` label.

The PR changes one line in `site/index.html`, renaming the theme button from "Switch theme" to "Change theme". It touches no guardrail files, workflows or secrets. The old label doesn't appear anywhere else in `site/`.

The four screenshots were 12,407 and 22,600 pixels tall and shrank to thumbnails when I opened them. I could only check that nothing looked broken. I couldn't judge spacing, typography or contrast in any detail.
